title: Impulse buying
situation: It's 11 PM, a flash sale pops up on a shopping app and you buy wireless earbuds you didn't plan for, "because it's 50% off".
consequence: 400,000 VND leaves your wallet in 10 seconds. Next week you're short on food money and the earbuds sit in a drawer.
fix: Use the 72-hour rule: put it in your cart, wait 3 days, then buy only if it still fits your 30% wants budget.

title: Ignoring small expenses
situation: Every day you spend 10k on parking, 20k on a soft drink and 15k on a snack. You think these amounts are "nothing".
consequence: 45,000 VND x 30 days = 1,350,000 VND a month, almost 1/3 of many students' allowance. Your wallet has an "invisible leak".
fix: Write down every expense, even 5,000 VND, in the Expense Planner for one month and see where your money really goes.

title: Late payments
situation: You forget the due date for your pay-later wallet or phone bill because you were busy with exams.
consequence: Late fees and penalty interest pile up, and missed payments can damage your CIC credit history for years.
fix: Set phone reminders 3 days before each due date and pay fixed bills first on the day you receive money.

title: Unused subscriptions
situation: You signed up for a music app, two streaming services and a cloud storage plan, but only really use one.
consequence: 4 subscriptions x 60,000-180,000 VND can cost over 400,000 VND a month for things you barely use.
fix: Check your bank/app store every month, cancel anything you didn't use in the last 30 days, or share a family plan.

title: Spending without a plan
situation: You don't split your allowance at the start of the month and just spend until the money runs out.
consequence: "Like a king at the start of the month, instant noodles at the end." Nothing is left for savings or surprises.
fix: Make a simple budget on day 1: split your income with the 50/30/20 calculator and pay yourself first (save 10-20% right away).
